messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary rollout 2026-03-15 10:45UTC failing for service=llm-inference (canary=20%). 15/18 pods crashlooping on nodepool=canary-1. Rolling-blocker? <https://console.redwood/rollouts/rl-9876|rollout link> :rotating_light:
sophia (oncall): paging @here I'm on it. Can confirm ~5 pods restarted rapidly, others reporting readiness probe failures. ETA to triage 5m.
jamal (eng-sre): looking at events -> `MountVolume.SetUp failed for volume "model-creds" : secret "model-creds-canary" not found` — manifests reference `model-creds-canary` but secret in cluster is `model-creds`.
lisa (infra): FYI we did a mass node-drain on canary-1 earlier for kernel patches, some pods rescheduled across tainted nodes during drain. Noticed HPA for this deployment dropped to 0 replicas for a short window because custom metric `rps` feed missed for ~3m (prometheus-scrape outage).
sophia (oncall): customer impact? Marco do we have errors in prod traces? I'm seeing increased 502/504 from EU regional gateway to model endpoints.
marco (product): seeing spike for tenants: acme-inc, beta-users. Error budget alarms firing. Suggest immediate kill-switch: disable header routing for `x-variant: canary` so traffic goes to stable. Will coordinate with API-gateway.
jamal (eng-sre): feature-flag flip looks safe — flag `enable-canary-serving` can be toggled via console. If we flip, traffic should shift off canary pods. Note: stable still on v12.3.4.
sophia (oncall): I'm going to flip the flag now. Posting steps for rollback and kill-switch:
```
# console quick toggle
POST https://flags.redwood/api/toggle
{ "flag": "enable-canary-serving", "value": false }
```
Executing in 10s...
(sophia toggles flag)
sophia (oncall): feature flag toggled -> false :white_check_mark: Routing change propagated to gateways.
deploy-bot: Observability: request errors for llm-inference down from 18% -> 2% in 60s. Latency stable. :tada:
lisa (infra): good. We still need to fix the root cause: manifest references a non-existent secret when deploying canary. That mismatch likely due to a templating bug in the kustomize overlay for `canary` patch. Propose: revert canary rollout to previous ReplicaSet and patch overlay. Also need to re-enable HPA metric scraping; prometheus-alerts show scrape job failed during node drain.
jamal (eng-sre): initiating rollback to rs/llm-inference-v12.3.4 now. `kubectl rollout undo deployment/llm-inference --to-revision=12` — roll back completed, new pods stable.
marco (product): Confirmed customer errors returning to baseline. Notifying CSMs for acme-inc and beta cohort.
sophia (oncall): Handing off incident to jamal for postmortem and follow-ups. Jamal you're the owner for the postmortem; lisa second for infra remediation; marco will coordinate customer comms. I'll update pagerduty and incident document.
jamal (eng-sre): Acknowledged. Immediate action items: 1) Fix kustomize overlay secret name and add a presubmit test to validate referenced secrets exist. 2) Add fallback in deployment entrypoint to fail fast if secret mount missing with informative logs. 3) Harden HPA metric fallback to avoid scale-to-zero during scrape blips.
lisa (infra): Also planning a safer drain procedure: stagger drains across canary nodes and verify prometheus scraping before finishing.
sophia (oncall): Created INC-20260315-1045, severity=prod-2, impact=multi-tenant partial (EU). Assigned to jamal. CSMs paged.
customer-bot: Incident INC-20260315-1045 created and CSMs notified.
marco (product): small note — let's avoid rolling canary + kernel updates simultaneously in same window. New rollout checklist item.
sophia (oncall): thanks team. I'll close handoff. Please add any follow-up comments here and I'll include them in the postmortem. :pray:
